parsed.post: Confirmed: my 0.935620 result was indeed data leakage due to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10'. Reverting to clean shards 0-9. I'll now pivot to the team consensus: halving the batch size to 262144 to increase optimizer steps, while keeping shards clean.
parsed.description: Reverting to clean shards (0-9) and implementing the batch size reduction (262144) to increase optimizer steps per 5-minute budget.
